title: Unforgettable Rajasthan Forts & Palaces
summary: 19 days covering Rajasthan in depth: Ranthambore tigers, Pushkar, Mount Abu, Jaisalmer and more.
note: The Taj Mahal remains closed on Fridays.

importantInfo.title: Booking & payment
importantInfo.body: Reserve now, pay later: book with a 15% advance deposit and pay the balance during the tour. Accepted: cash on arrival, credit card or PayPal.

importantInfo.title: Cancellation
importantInfo.body: For multi-day packages, please confirm cancellation terms with our team at the time of booking.

importantInfo.title: Hotels
importantInfo.body: 4 & 5 star category hotels, with heritage options on request.

importantInfo.title: Customisation
importantInfo.body: Every trip is 100% tailor-made to your pace, interests and budget. Ask us for a free quote.

importantInfo.title: Guide languages
importantInfo.body: Live guides are available in English, Spanish, German, French, Russian and Japanese.
